description: VeyrPiano gives users an interactive piano roll inside ChatGPT for creating and continuing shared musical compositions. Users can draw, move, resize, audition, remove, undo, and redo notes; adjust sustain and tempo; and hand the piece to ChatGPT for one bounded additive musical move. Human-created notes appear green and ChatGPT-created notes appear blue, preserving visible authorship as the piece develops. An active composition can be explicitly reopened later and continued from its latest authoritative state.

defaultPrompt: Open a blank 120 BPM piano roll so I can sketch a melody.
Build a simple chord progression in E minor and open it for me to edit.
Start a call-and-response melody with a short four-note phrase, then hand the piano roll to me.
